name: Shan'do
summary: Among the night elves, Shan'do is spoken with deep respect for a mentor and guide. The Darnassian title means “honored teacher” or “honored instructor,” while thero'shan honors a student.

sections.title: A Title of Deep Reverence
sections.body: In Darnassian, shan'do means “honored teacher” or “honored instructor.” Calling an elder or mentor shan'do shows humility, filial devotion, and lasting respect for their guidance.

sections.title: The Lineage of the Druids
sections.body: The Cenarion Circle's history is bound to the title. Before the War of the Ancients, the demigod Cenarius taught Malfurion Stormrage the ways of nature as his shan'do. Malfurion then guided generations of mortal druids. Across Kalimdor, night elves, forest keepers, and reverent allies commonly address him as Shan'do Stormrage.

sections.title: Mentors Beyond the Circle
sections.body: Cenarion druids often use the title for mentors such as Naralex or the slumbering Malfurion. Yet shan'do belongs to the Darnassian language and reaches beyond religious life. It marks the bond between master and pupil, whatever their school of thought.

faq.q: What does the word shan'do actually mean?
faq.answer: In Darnassian, shan'do means “honored teacher” or “honored instructor.” The title shows deep respect and gratitude toward a mentor.

faq.q: What is the opposite or student version of shan'do?
faq.answer: The complementary honorific is thero'shan, meaning “honored student.” Mentors use it for apprentices to recognize their devotion and discipline.

faq.q: Who is most commonly called Shan'do?
faq.answer: Night elves and the Cenarion Circle most commonly hail Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage as Shan'do. Cenarius was called shan'do by his first pupils, and followers also use the title for prominent leaders such as Naralex.

faq.q: Is the title shan'do only used by druids?
faq.answer: No. Shan'do comes from Cenarion druidic tradition, but it is a Darnassian courtesy. A student can use it for a master of craft, magic, or wisdom.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know shan'do as a solemn courtesy for an elder or teacher, carrying millennia of cultural weight.
As a druid, you trace your teachings through mentors back to Shan'do Stormrage and Cenarius. Speaking the title honors that chain.
As a tauren druid studying alongside the night elves in Moonglade, you recognize shan'do and use it respectfully for mentors such as Malfurion Stormrage.
